spans.s:
n. (-क्रं)
An army in motion, or as sometimes explained, foraging.
E.
प्र before चक्र a division.

m. (-क्षाः)
The regent of Jupiter, VṚHASPATI.
E.
प्र before चक्ष to speak, Uṇādi aff. असुन्.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
1 Excessively hot or burning.
2 Intolerable, insupportable.
3 Bold, confident, presuming.
4 Wrathful, passionate.
5 Violent, strong.
m. (-ण्डः)
A sort of Nerium with white flowers.
f. (-ण्डा)
One of DURGĀ'S emanations or attendants.
E.
प्र very, चण्ड hot, &c.

m. (-र्त्तिः)
A tree, (Tapia cratæva.)
E.
प्रचण्ड Nerium, and मूर्त्ति form.

m. (-यः)
1 A heap, a quantity, a number.
2 Gathering, (as fruit or flowers, but especially by means of a stick or other implement.)
3 Slight union or aggregation.
E.
प्र before चि to gather, aff. अच्; also with घञ् aff., प्रचाय.

m. (-यः)
Gathering any thing with the hand.
E.
प्र, चि to collect, घञ् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A road, a path.
2 Usage, custom, currency.
3 Going well or widely.
E.
प्र before चर to go, aff. ट; also with घञ् aff., प्रचार.

m. (-रः)
1 Going, proceeding.
2 Custom, usage.
3

Conduct.
4

Currency.
5

Appearance, manifestation.
6 Pasture ground.
E.
प्र before चर to go, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Contrary to rectitude, deviating from the ordinary institutions and observances.
E.
प्र reverse, and आचार ordinance.

n. (-णं)
1 Going, proceeding.
2 Circulating, being current.
E.
प्र before चर to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
Going, well, quickly, widely, &c.
E.
प्र before चर to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone, going.
2 Pursued, practised, (as an art or business.)
E.
प्र before चर to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 What goes much or widely.
2 Current, circulating, customary.
E.
प्र before चल to go, अच् aff.

m. (-लः)
The stick or body of the Vīṇā or lute.
E.
प्र before चल to go, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्)
1 Going, proceeding far or much.
2 Prevailing, circulating, being customary or current.
3 Being recognised, (as authority or law, &c.)
E.
प्र before चल to go, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Moving, going much or widely.
2 Circulating, being customary or current.
E.
प्र before चल to go, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A peacock's tail.
2 Archery, shooting with arrows.
3 A snake.
E.
प्र before चल to go, aff. आकन्.

m. (-की)
1 A snake.
2 A peacock.
E.
प्रचलाक a peacock's tail, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Rolling about, tossing, tumbling, (as in sleep.)
E.
प्र before चल to go, in the causal form, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone far or wide, wandering, roving.
2 Set in motion, shaken.
3 Current, customary, circulating, prevailing.
4 Recognised, received, (as authority or law, &c.)
5 Rolling (as the eye).
E.
प्र before चल to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Collected, gathered together.
n. (-तं)
A species of the Daṇḍaka metre.
E.
प्र before चि to assemble, क्त aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Much, many.
E.
प्र before चुर to steal, क aff.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Abounding with men, populous, numerous.
m. (-षः)
A thief.
E.
प्रचुर, and पुरुष a man.

n. (-णं)
Adding to, augmenting, increasing.
E.
प्रचुर, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Augmented, in quantity or number.
E.
प्रचुर, and कृत make, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः)
Happy, delighted.
m. (-ताः)
1 VARUṆA, the regent of water.
2 The name of a saint and lawgiver.
m. plu. (-सः)
The ten sons of PRĀCĪNAVARHIS by the daughter of VARUṆA, and the progenitors of DAKṢA.
E.
प्र best, first, चेतस् the heart.

m. (-ता)
A charioteer.
E.
प्र before चि to collect, (the reins,) aff. तृच्.

m. (-लः)
A yellow fragrant wood.
E.
प्र before चेल to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-कः)
A horse.
E.
प्र well, fast, चेल to go, वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Saying, enjoining, prescribing.
2 Sending, directing.
3 A rule or law.
E.
प्र before चुद to direct, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Prescribed, directed.
2 Sent, directed.
E.
प्र thoroughly, चुद to direct, aff. क्त.

f. (-नी)
A prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.)
E.
प्र before चुद to send, aff. ल्यु and ङीप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fallen from, deviated from.
E.
प्र before च्यु to fall, क्त aff.

(औ) प्रच्छौ r. 6th cl. (पृच्छति)
1 To ask or inquire.
2 To desire, to know.

f. (-णा)
Asking, addressing, inviting.
E.
प्रच्छ to ask, aff. युच्.

m. (-दः)
A cover, a wrapper.
E.
प्र completely, छद to cover, aff. अञ्च्.

m. (-टः)
A cover, a wrapper, either of a person or thing, as a cloak, a veil, a sheet, a curtain, &c.
E.
प्रच्छद a cover, and पट cloth.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Covered, clothed.
2 Unavowed, disguised.
3 Private, concealed, secret.
n. (-न्नं)
1 A private door within a house.
2 A lattice, a loop hole.
3 Any private door.
E.
प्र before च्छद to hide, aff. क्त, what is concealed or secret.

f. (-का)
Vomiting, sickness.
E.
प्र violently, छर्द to vomit, aff. ण्वुल्.

n. (-नं)
1 An upper or outer garment.
2 Covering, concealing.
E.
प्र completely, छद to cover, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Covered, clothed, hidden, concealed.
E.
प्र before छद to cover, aff. क्त.

प्राच् or प्राञ्च
mfn. (प्राङ् प्राची प्राक्)
1 East, eastern.
2 Before, in front.
3 Former, prior, first.
4 At top, above.
f. (-ची)
The east.
E.
प्र before अञ्ज to go, aff. क्विन्.

m. (-र्य्यः)
A scholar, a pupil.
E.
प्र meaning प्राप्त obtained, and आचार्य्य a preceptor.

f. (-का)
1 A musquito.
2 The female falcon.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 East, eastern.
2 Former, prior, ancient, old.
3 Placed towards the east.
fn. (-ना-नं)
A bound hedge, a fence, a wall.
f. (-ना)
1 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
2 The ichneumon plant: see रास्ना.
E.
प्राच् the east, aff. ख.

m. (-कः)
The moon.
E.
प्राचीन eastern, and तिलक mark.

m. (-सः)
A tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
E.
प्राचीन् eastern, and पनस the jack.

m. (-र्हिः)
1 A name of

INDRA.
2

A king.
E.
प्राचीन eastern, and वर्हिस् light; presiding over the eastern quarter.

m. (-कः)
A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)
E.
प्राचीन eastern, आमलक myrobalan.

n. (-तं)
The sacrificial thread, worn over the right arm, and passing under the left, as at Śrāddhas.
E.
प्राचीन east, and आवीत hung.

m. (-ती)
A Brahman wearing his cord over his right shoulder, as at Śrāddhas.
E.
प्राचीतावीत, and इनि aff.

m. (-तिः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
प्राची the east, and पति master, regent.

n. (-रं)
A bound hedge, a fence, a wall, an inclosure, a rampart.
E.
प्र and आङ prefixed to चि to collect, aff. क्रन्, and the radical vowel made long.

m. (-सः)
VĀLMĪKI, the author of the Rāmāyaṇa.
m. plu. (-साः)
The ten sons of Prācīnavarhis.
E.
प्रचेतस, the father of the poet, and अण् aff.; it also occurs प्राचेतस् (-ताः.)

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
Eastern, easterly.
m. (-च्यः)
The eastern country, the country south or east of the SARASVATĪ, which [] flows from the north-east to the south-west.
E.
प्राच् the east, aff. यत्.

m. (-प्राट)
An inquirer, a questioner.
E.
प्रच्छ to ask, aff. क्विप्.
